discoveries: Реализован явный preflight configuration handoff через обычный и native install; durable regeneration/analyzer читают опубликованную selection.

Eager content включён в фактический boot output. Lazy-push передаёт description, captured declaration reference и MCP read request через существующий INDEX; lazy-pull доступен по query/read без boot content.
Native descriptor consumer получает отдельный captured SubskillManifest witness; существующая package.sources validation сохранена.
MCP читает lock-selected slots; новый derived-view path не заполняет legacy copy rows и не копирует subskill files в project tree.
Independent Agent Skills не сопоставляются с subskills; fixture проверяет реальную неизменную projection в .agents/skills/independent.

resolved_findings.observation: First compile failed: newly explicit native preflight signature missed compatibility caller.
resolved_findings.resolution: Updated ordinary native caller to supply durable configuration; Ready uses explicit preflight path.

resolved_findings.observation: Whole materialized-slot hash differed from source hash in first install fixture.
resolved_findings.resolution: Existing generated boot artifacts are not captured source. Fixture compares every source file with its materialized counterpart and compares complete captured source hashes across activation states.

resolved_findings.observation: Native selected-source compiler rejected subskill content without root package.sources row.
resolved_findings.resolution: Added explicit selected SubskillManifest witnesses; recheck declaration digest and content bytes before native compilation, retaining descriptor refusal regression.

resolved_findings.observation: Lazy-push description did not appear in INDEX when carried only in display origin.
resolved_findings.resolution: Added typed SubskillOffer provenance and INDEX comments; actual output assertions now succeed.

effect_uncertainty: Evidence covers local Rust fixtures and generated/read output. No live agent task matching or model invocation was performed; matching an offered description and requesting content remains with the consuming agent. No deployment or Git publication was performed.
